name: Payment terms objection
description: Customer receives a quote then asks about paying on account because they don't have cash now, testing the AI's ability to handle a payment terms objection

messages.text: Hi, I'm Pieter. Can I get a quote for 20 sheets of white melamine chipboard 16mm?
Can I pay on account? I don't have cash now

expected_behaviors.description: AI should handle the objection with empathy and clarify payment options or terms
AI should re-attempt a close after handling the objection
Objection handling reply should arrive within 15 seconds

forbidden_patterns.description: Tags should be stripped from customer-facing message
AI should not give up after a single objection

notes: Payment terms objection. AI should explain available payment methods (EFT, card, account for established customers), offer alternatives, and re-attempt a close.
